fixes.explanation: Right. God says they eat unleavened bread for seven days in the month of Abib “…because that was the month you came out of Egypt.” (Exodus 23:15) The leaving is the reason He gives for that month. I can't even remember what I ate last Tuesday, and Israel gets a whole month with the day they walked out of Egypt attached to it.

Leftovers aren't what God asks for, friend. He says, “Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God.” (Exodus 23:19) You wouldn't hand a guest whatever was at the back of the cabinet and call it a gift. You'd set out your best. God asks for the best of the firstfruits.

problems.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

The explanation says the feast was given to help the Israelites remember the day they left Egypt. The verse gives their departure as the reason for holding it in Abib, but does not state that purpose for the feast.
